description: arXiv:2609.07139v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A transformer can make an attribute linearly decodable in its residual stream at a depth where that attribute does not yet influence the output. This gap between where information is readable and where it is used has been shown for attributes stated directly in the input. We ask whether it also holds for an attribute the model must infer gradually...
author: Mika Okamoto, Gabriele Sarti
